create_tfrecord_dataloader: create a TFRecordDataLoader to load BERT TFRecords with configurable batch size and sequence length
build_record_converter: build a Record2Example converter to decode BERT TF records into TensorFlow examples with a feature map
convert_tf_to_torch: convert a TensorFlow example dict to PyTorch tensors with masked language model mask and label arrays
